# Alo Yoga

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 22 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Fashion e-commerce storefront: monochrome black-on-white Shopify + Builder.io surface, uppercase small-cap chrome, square PDP colour tiles and grid colour dots, member-price hooks, a full --color-* ramp set behind an achromatic surface.

Captured 2026-11-11, signed out (every captured surface is public; checkout, the bag drawer and account behind sign-in were never reached). Themes: light.

A token set and component reference for Alo Yoga's public storefront — for building fashion-e-commerce surfaces in the style of the real thing. It was read from **aloyoga.com** (served at `/en-sg`) on **2026-11-11**, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844: the home, women's and men's shop grids, new arrivals, a product page discovered at run time, New to Alo, the cart, and the public account-login gate.

Alo is worth a capture because it is a current reference for a monochrome storefront: black-on-white primary actions, uppercase small-cap nav on 84px chrome, colour-dot and square-tile swatch systems with an out-of-stock state, a member-price hook woven into every tile, and a full `--color-*` design-system ramp set behind the scenes that the surface itself barely uses — the storefront is nearly achromatic on purpose.

## Typography

No composite type styles in tokens.json; the README text below names the faces and sizes.

### Fonts (from README.md)

**Proxima Nova** (`--primary-font`) is Alo's licensed face — every headline, nav item, button and price. It is not distributed; the style guide falls back to Helvetica/system. 276 `@font-face` rules were recorded across the sheets in [raw/css-vars.json](raw/css-vars.json) (many are icon/vendor faces); the storefront itself is sans-only.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- **One theme only.** The `dark` probe resolves to the same `:root` values — nothing paints dark. `tokens.json` ships no dark set.
- **Vendor vars are not the shop.** `.s-mode-*`/`.s-theme-*` (an embedded third-party app's theme kit, ~500 rules) and `--osano-*` are binned `vendor` in css-vars.json and excluded from tokens.
- **`component.*` tokens are measured**, not site variables.
- **`color-tile` and `to-top` missed their selectors** on this pass (lazy Builder.io blocks); recorded as missing, visible in screenshots.
- **Quantised screenshots.** `screenshots/` are 256-colour PNGs; read exact colours from tokens or `raw/full/`.
- **The PDP is a sample**, not a fixed product — see `pdp_url`.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do keep the storefront achromatic.** White ground, `#111`/`#242424`/`#3b3b3b` ink, `#636363` secondary, `#e1e1e1`/`#f2f2f2` surfaces. Colour lives in product imagery, not chrome. See [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png).
2. **Do run the two-button vocabulary.** Filled black `--primary` uppercase for the action that ends a flow; hairline ghost for the sibling. See [add-to-bag-default](components/crops/add-to-bag-default.png) and [wishlist-button-default](components/crops/wishlist-button-default.png).
3. **Do keep controls square-edged.** The hero and buy buttons are sharp-cornered; size chips and colour tiles are square. See [size-button-default](components/crops/size-button-default.png).
4. **Do use the square colour tile on PDPs, the dot on grids.** PDP swatches are 46px labelled squares; grid swatches are 26px dots with an active ring. See [pdp-swatch-default](components/crops/pdp-swatch-default.png) and [swatch-selected-default](components/crops/swatch-selected-default.png).
5. **Don't let the `--color-*` accent ramps drive chrome.** They exist for tags, charts and status — the storefront stays monochrome. See [raw/css-vars.json](raw/css-vars.json).
6. **Don't ship a dark theme.** None is offered or declared for the storefront.
7. **Don't treat vendor widget styles as Alo's.** `.s-mode-*`/`.s-theme-*` and `--osano-*` belong to embedded apps. See the `vendor` bin in [raw/css-vars.json](raw/css-vars.json).
8. **Don't reach for rounded cards or shadows for tiles.** Product surfaces are square tiles separated by spacing, not bordered cards. See [product-tile-default](components/crops/product-tile-default.png).
